reference: If he held the screwdriver, that shelf would be on the floor by now.
sk: Keby skrutkovač držal on, tá polica by už dávno bola na zemi.
cz: Kdyby šroubovák držel on, ta police by už dávno byla na zemi.
acceptable: If {he held|he were holding|he was holding|he were the one holding|he was the one holding} the screwdriver, {that|the} shelf would be on the {floor|ground} by now.
If {he held|he were holding|he was holding|he were the one holding|he was the one holding} the screwdriver, {that|the} shelf would already be on the {floor|ground}.
{That|The} shelf would {already |}be on the {floor|ground} by now if {he held|he were holding|he was holding} the screwdriver.

mistakes.text: If he holds the screwdriver, {that|the} shelf would be on the floor by now.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Situácia je nereálna, preto v Second Conditional patrí po „if“ Past Simple: „if he held“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Situace je nereálná, proto ve Second Conditional patří po „if“ Past Simple: „if he held“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The situation is unreal, so Second Conditional uses Past Simple after “if”: “if he held”.

mistakes.text: If he would hold the screwdriver, {that|the} shelf would be on the floor by now.
mistakes.feedback_sk: V Second Conditional sa po „if“ „would“ nepíše; správne je „if he held“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Ve Second Conditional se po „if“ „would“ nepíše; správně je „if he held“.
mistakes.feedback_en: In Second Conditional don't use “would” after “if”; say “if he held”.

mistakes.text: If he held the screwdriver, {that|the} shelf will be on the floor by now.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Nereálny následok vyjadruje „would be“, nie „will be“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Nereálný následek vyjadřuje „would be“, ne „will be“.
mistakes.feedback_en: An unreal result needs “would be”, not “will be”.

mistakes.text: If he held the screwdriver, {that|the} shelf would be on the floor until now.
mistakes.kind: until now instead of by now
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Už“ v zmysle „do tejto chvíle“ je „by now“; „until now“ znamená „doteraz“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Už“ ve smyslu „do této chvíle“ je „by now“; „until now“ znamená „dosud“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “By now” means at this point already; “until now” means up to now.

mistakes.text: If he hold the screwdriver, {that|the} shelf would be on the floor by now.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „if“ v Second Conditional patrí minulý tvar slovesa: „held“, nie „hold“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „if“ ve Second Conditional patří minulý tvar slovesa: „held“, ne „hold“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Second Conditional needs the past form after “if”: “held”, not “hold”.

source_issues: Slovak and Czech stress who holds it (“on”) and add “už dávno” (long ago); the English “by now” does not show this emphasis.
